sentences.en: Scientific discoveries don't always make the world a better place.
sentences.zh: 科学发现并不总是能让世界变得更好。

sentences.en: How is the discovery related to the progress of science?
sentences.zh: 这个发现与科学的进步有什么关系？

sentences.en: The laboratory acquired a fabulous reputation for its historic discovery.
sentences.zh: 实验室因其历史性的发现而声名远播。
